name: emerald
author: Kfir Raphael Eliyahu <me@kfireliyahu.com>
description: Excel that reads your documents and won't let you be wrong quietly. Local-first and document-based: what you and an AI worked out, kept true in a file you own.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs dist
scripts.build:plugin: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode frame && vite build --mode plugin && vite build --mode claude-hooks && vite build --mode claude-status-line && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs dist-plugin
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:plugin && node scripts/make-demo-document.mjs && vite build --mode demo && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs dist-demo
scripts.build:electron: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode electron && vite build --mode electron-preload
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac
